metadata.statistical_discipline: Five frozen E checkpoints are the independent units; the three resampling replicates per seed are nested draws, not independent checkpoints. Readers are analysis-only, fitted on held-out-excluded ordinary-ADD pools, tuned on V's canonical VAL, evaluated once on the untouched canonical TEST at the best-on-VAL state. Model initialization is matched across conditions (same av.reader_seed); sampling seeds are separate. Selection is VAL-only. Majority baselines are training-derived; balanced accuracy and per-class recall are reported so raw-accuracy changes from label composition are not mistaken for rule recovery. V-A/V-B are unchanged.

primary_decision.rule_note: Descriptive (categories, not acceptance thresholds). transfer_signal if a bootstrap condition improves held-out Class-A balanced accuracy over ae_native in >=4/5 seeds AND improves >10/20 held-out operand pairs; fit_change if training accuracy changes (either direction) by >=0.15 in >=4/5 seeds. sampling_sensitive_fit_transfer_gap if any transfer signal; else persistent_fit_without_transfer if training fit changes consistently but held-out balanced accuracy stays weak/inconsistent; else inconclusive_mixed. Replicates are nested draws, not independent checkpoints. V-A/V-B are not altered.

accessibility.note: V's V-A accessibility criterion is unchanged; AG does not re-define it.
